appearances.title: Devin Fusion scores 68 on coding agent index
appearances.summary: Cognition reports Devin Fusion scored 68 on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, with Opus 5.5 as the lead model and GPT-6 Luna as a sidekick, beating Claude Code with Opus 5.5 at 31% lower cost per task. It is available in the Devin CLI.
